display.summary: Entry Clipboard and stack schema stamps from 1.11.0b1, plus an image update that ends when DjangoLux is back instead of stranding the operator on the maintenance page.
highlights: Image updates: the progress dialog stays locked, starts with an empty log, and offers Finish once the site is back on the new image.
The maintenance page returns to the page you were on as soon as the site answers (new projects; Composer 1.6.1b2 check --fix updates stock pages).
A deployment whose image moved to an older DjangoLux is offered updates again.
Entry Clipboard (Extra Features, off by default) and stack schema stamps with the stack.schema doctor check.
